description: Solid rocket motor static fire (KNSB, 5 grain segments), SNU Rocket Team HANARO. Sample data from github.com/snu-hanaro/static-fire-toolkit (MIT License).
engine_type: solid rocket motor (no valves, no feed system, no simulation prediction)
time_base: DAQ clock of the thrust channel, seconds

Pc.note: logged at ~10 Hz and linearly interpolated onto the 100 Hz grid

F_thrust.note: irregular DAQ timing; grid points > 25 ms from a raw sample are NaN

thrust_calibration.method: least squares against HANARO processed thrust
